evals.prompt: Review our Android trading screen designed by copying the iPhone version: tab bar with 6 tabs, back chevron 'Portfolio' at top-left, segmented control, content stops below the status bar, 40x40 dp icon buttons. It must also run on tablets and foldables.
evals.expected_output: A review recommending a navigation bar with 3-5 destinations on compact and a rail on medium/expanded, removal of the iOS back chevron label in favour of top app bar navigation and predictive back, segmented buttons or tabs, edge-to-edge with insets, 48 dp targets, and medium/expanded layouts such as list-detail.
assertions: Six tabs are reduced or moved to a drawer or rail
40x40 dp targets are flagged against 48 dp
Tablet and foldable layouts are proposed per window size class
